title: Sum of Two Integers
description: Write a **public** Java class named `Solution` with a public static method `sum` that takes two integers, `a` and `b`, and returns their sum.

title: Factorial Calculation
description: Write a public static method `factorial` that calculates the **factorial** of a non-negative integer `n`. The method should be inside a class named `Solution`. Assume input will not exceed 12.

title: Reverse a String
description: Implement a **public static method** `reverse` within the `Solution` class that takes a String and returns a new String with the characters in reverse order.

title: Snail Class Simulation
description: Create two classes: a **`Snail`** class with private fields for its name and speed, a constructor, and a public `move` method. Then, create a **`Solution`** class containing a public static `simulateRace` method that instantiates and uses the `Snail` class. The compiler will run the `Solution` class. Ensure both classes are defined in the editor.
